oracle.material: the packaged 0.1.5 install: package.json exports/main/types entry points, then exported symbols in those .d.ts files, one re-export level deep
whyTrustworthy: a name is offered only when it is either observed by a kernel probe (measured) or exported by the packaged build under its declared entry point
the previous pass read every "name: Type" line inside interface Context, which is what let plain properties in; this pass never looks at Context declarations
stillUnknown: a renamed service whose old AND new symbol names both exist as exports is invisible here
JS-only packages with no .d.ts contribute no symbols
the tier says the NAME existed, not that its CONTRACT matched; contract drift lives in compat/table/**

countsAreMethodDependent.note: scannedEntryFiles/exportedSymbols depend on the entry-point and re-export rules used. An independent implementation (R18-verify.md) counted 2,562 entry files and 5,296 exported symbols over the same tree, i.e. 2.9x and 1.3x these numbers. Read them as "this method reached at least this many", not as a property of the install.
